content: Nominasyonji ɗiɗi ɗiɗi konngi ɗi nanndaa: Biftor Best Picture, Jangoowo (Director), Cinematography, Ñaawo Ɓeyngu (Costume Design), Naataade Filmo (Film-editing), Maɓɓeendi Nawnaare (Original Score), Naataade Jokkondiral (Production Design), Sokki Ndawu (Sound Editing), Sokki Weendu (Sound Mixing) e Naataare Leemsaare (Original Screenplay).
